parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  user_id: $json._user.user_id,
  company: $json.ai_company || $json.company_name || $json.company || 'Unknown',
  role: $json.title || $json.job_title || 'Unknown',
  job_url: $json.absolute_url || $json.url || $json.job_url || '',
  location: $json.ai_location || ($json.location && $json.location.name ? $json.location.name : ($json.candidate_required_location || 'Not specified')),
  remote: Boolean($json.ai_remote),
  employment_type: $json.employment_type || 'permanent',
  salary_min: $json.salary_min ?? null,
  salary_max: $json.salary_max ?? null,
  salary_currency: $json.salary_currency || 'GBP',
  day_rate_min: $json.day_rate_min ?? null,
  day_rate_max: $json.day_rate_max ?? null,
  contact_email: $json.contact_email || null,
  ai_score: $json.ai_score ?? null,
  ai_reasoning: $json.ai_reasoning || null
}) }}
